prose: An analysis of Anthropic's S-1 asks whether revenue can outgrow its compute bill. Seven disclosed deals total $644 billion and total committed spending is about $895 billion, including one counterparty payment of over half of annualized Q3 revenue once fully delivered. Compute fell from 251% of revenue in Q1 2025 to 48% in Q2 2026, then rose to 58% in Q3 ($9.9B on $17.0B revenue), and an operating profit of $974M became a $567M loss, blamed mostly on $5.0B of costly short-term compute and $2.0B of non-cash donation matching. The piece works backward from commitments to the revenue needed to support them.
highlights: $644B in seven deals; about $895B total commitments
Compute 48% of revenue in Q2, 58% in Q3
Q3 operating loss $567M after a $974M Q2 profit
Short-term compute costs more than multi-year contracts
Estimates revenue needed to cover commitments
